title: M5.3: Implementasi Lengkap Aksi Hamburger Menu (Right Panel)
description:
Mengimplementasikan seluruh 8 aksi pada menu burger popup di kanan bawah:

* Folder Game (dialog browse folder)
* Perbarui Patch ID (check patch status)
* Perbarui Launcher (check update release)
* Paksa Tutup Game (kill process `Client-Win64-Shipping.exe`)
* Jalankan sebagai Admin (UAC elevation `runas`)
* Kirim Log Diagnostik (compress zip & upload service)
* Reset Cache Tampilan (clear webview & media cache)
* Hapus Patch ID (uninstall patch & restore sig).

projectMilestone.name: M5: Full Feature Parity & Live Asset Integration
